note: What the layout probe expects to find. Anything in here that stops being true is reported as a failure rather than quietly dropped, because a region that silently stops being a scroll container silently stops carrying its own requirement.
densityNote: Expectations are per density because the visual deliberately changes shape with the tile. At minimal density the diagnostics strip is reduced to a screen-reader-only region and is no longer a scroll container - that is a decision, recorded here, rather than a check that quietly evaporated.

(unset).unsetNote: A build that publishes no density at all - anything from before the density mechanism existed. Kept so the probe can still measure an older artifact for a before-and-after comparison rather than refusing to run on it.

statesNote: The states the suite must probe. Pinned for the same reason the sticky count is: a state that disappears takes its findings with it and leaves a smaller run that still reports zero violations. diagnostics-tree-focused is the one worth naming - it is where a diagnostics message and a focused tree pane compete, and where the chart went from 0px visible to 185px.
countsNote: Zero sticky and zero fixed elements. This visual pins nothing, so the sticky rules currently have nothing to run on - which is exactly why the count is pinned here. The day a sticky header appears this file fails, and the sticky checks get wired up before the header ships.

minimumSizes.minimumNote: canvasHeight is the scrollport onto the chart. visibleChartHeight is how much of the graph actually falls inside that scrollport - the graph carries min-height: 170px and scrolls, so it never collapses on its own and asserting its height would pass on a 170px chart behind a 6px window.
minimumSizes.visibleChartNote: One whole node card, which is 48px plus the 12px layout padding above it: below that a reader cannot see a single complete node. Capped at a fraction of the tile because an 80x80 tile cannot afford 60px of chart alongside anything else, and a floor no layout can satisfy is a floor nobody can act on.
